title: Upstream openmls GREASE KeyPackage extension fix
description: Per JMAP-6k5d.1 decision (crates.io deps only; upstream fork-only fixes). crates.io openmls 0.9.1 src/extensions/mod.rs maps Extension::Unknown(kind) to ExtensionType::Unknown even for GREASE values (RFC 9420 13.5), while a capabilities list decodes the same value as ExtensionType::Grease. KeyPackageIn::validate then fails capabilities().contains_extensions() with KeyPackageVerifyError::UnsupportedExtension, so a correctly GREASEd KeyPackage is rejected. Fix exists only in github.com/MarkAtwood/openmls commit 5abd9e0 (fix: classify GREASE KeyPackage extensions as Grease), used by mimid via [patch.crates-io]. Effect on crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server: KeyPackage/set create would reject such KeyPackages with invalidProperties keyPackage (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 L197 'does not parse'/'signature does not verify' bucket). Action: open an upstream PR to openmls/openmls; once released, bump the pin. Until then, document the limitation in the mimi-server README Gotchas.
